qualificationRule: All named tests must pass for the same commit/version and shipped binary bytes on native Linux amd64 and arm64. Test overlays add harness tools only. Rehearsal fixtures and emulation never authorize publication.

registryAppToken.constraints: Short-lived installation/app token scoped to firewall packages only; no contents write, releases, tags, administration or delete permission. Provision outside this workflow. GHCR must support the chosen app credential; otherwise use the job-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN with packages:write. Never expand to a repository-wide PAT.
